nodes.description: Public base URI string used to build token metadata URIs; writable by owner via setBaseURI.
Public metadata file extension appended in tokenURI; writable by owner via setBaseExtension.
Public mint price in wei (0 ether); used in cost * _mintAmount payment check inside mint.
Public cap on total token supply (28); enforced in mint via supply + _mintAmount <= maxSupply.
Public per-transaction mint cap (28); enforced in mint and mutable by owner via setmaxMintAmount.
Public pause flag; mint requires !paused, toggled by owner via pause.
Ownable owner address; gates all onlyOwner administrative setters.
FramedGallery constructor: sets base URI and pre-mints 28 tokens to msg.sender during deployment.
Payable public mint; validates paused, amount bounds and supply cap, charges non-owner callers, then loops _safeMint.
View helper returning the array of token IDs owned by a given address.
Returns metadata URI by concatenating baseURI, tokenId and baseExtension for existing tokens.
onlyOwner setter that overwrites maxMintAmount.
onlyOwner setter that overwrites baseURI.
onlyOwner setter that overwrites baseExtension.
onlyOwner toggle that sets the paused flag, halting minting.
Internal virtual override returning the baseURI state variable.
Inherited ERC721 internal mint that calls _mint and then checks the receiver, invoking an external callback for contract recipients.
Inherited ERC721 internal mint that stores ownership and balances for a new token ID.
Inherited ERC721 hook performing a try/catch external call to onERC721Received on contract recipients.
Caller-controlled address; decides whether the mint payment check applies and is used by Ownable checks.
External, attacker-controllable callback into a recipient contract during _safeMint/_checkOnERC721Received; classic reentrancy entry point.
Multiplication cost * _mintAmount used in the payment requirement inside mint.
Addition supply + _mintAmount used for the max supply check and token ID assignment in mint.
